import sys

def find_center(n, adj):
    def bfs(start, need_parent):
        dist = [-1] * n
        parent = [-1] * n if need_parent else None
        dist[start] = 0
        q = [start]
        head = 0
        far = start

        while head < len(q):
            u = q[head]
            head += 1

            if dist[u] > dist[far]:
                far = u

            for v in adj[u]:
                if dist[v] == -1:
                    dist[v] = dist[u] + 1
                    if need_parent:
                        parent[v] = u
                    q.append(v)

        return far, dist, parent

    a, _, _ = bfs(0, False)
    b, dist, parent = bfs(a, True)

    d = dist[b]
    cur = b
    for _ in range(d // 2):
        cur = parent[cur]

    return cur + 1


def main():
    data = list(map(int, sys.stdin.buffer.read().split()))
    if not data:
        return

    it = iter(data)
    n = next(it)
    m = next(it)

    adj1 = [[] for _ in range(n)]
    for _ in range(n - 1):
        a = next(it) - 1
        b = next(it) - 1
        adj1[a].append(b)
        adj1[b].append(a)

    adj2 = [[] for _ in range(m)]
    for _ in range(m - 1):
        x = next(it) - 1
        y = next(it) - 1
        adj2[x].append(y)
        adj2[y].append(x)

    c1 = find_center(n, adj1)
    c2 = find_center(m, adj2)

    sys.stdout.write(f"{c1} {c2}\n")


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
